newsitem.title: USA: PREMIS signs extended deal with Gymboree.
newsitem.headline: PREMIS signs extended deal with Gymboree.

text.p: PREMIS Corp said Monday it signed an extended agreement with Gymboree Corp, continuing the efforts to increase operating efficiencies at Gymboree's children's apparel stores.

PREMIS said it has rolled out programs at 311 stores, with the complete launch of all 384 North American stores scheduled for completion by July 1997. The program included online check and credit processing and customer profiling, among other things.
The extended agreement includes additional functionalities to be implemented in later phases of the project, PREMIS said.
PREMIS provides enterprise-wide retail automation programs and products.
